name: DropUI – Popups, Cart Abandonment Recovery and Marketing Automation
author: dropui

sections.description:
Turn more WordPress visitors into customers

DropUI is a campaign platform for WordPress and WooCommerce. Create targeted popups, bars, embedded forms, product recommendations, web push notifications, and WhatsApp campaigns from one dashboard.

Use DropUI to recover abandoned carts, collect leads, increase average order value, and bring visitors back after they leave your website.

DropUI works on WordPress websites with or without WooCommerce. When WooCommerce is active, campaigns can use data about products, categories, variations, coupons, cart contents, cart value, free-shipping thresholds, and checkout stage.

Create campaigns from scratch, start with a prebuilt campaign template, or use the AI Assistant to generate campaign copy, layout, and calls to action. A DropUI account is required, and a free plan is available.

What can you do with DropUI?

  • Recover abandoned WooCommerce carts – re-engage shoppers with a relevant offer, discount code, or free-shipping incentive.
  • Increase average order value – show progress toward free shipping, a free gift, or a discount based on cart value.
  • Collect leads and marketing opt-ins – use popups and embedded forms to grow your contact list.
  • Recommend products and create upsells – promote bestsellers and bundles, or offer relevant upsells and cross-sells based on the page or product a visitor is viewing.
  • Bring visitors back – send web push notifications or WhatsApp messages after they leave your website.
  • Personalize campaigns – target visitors using page, device, language, traffic source, behavior, and WooCommerce data.
  • Measure and improve performance – track impressions, clicks, click-through rates, conversions, and A/B test results.

Built for WordPress, enhanced for WooCommerce

On any WordPress website, you can use popups, bars, embedded forms, Feed, web push notifications, WhatsApp, and behavior-based display rules.

In WooCommerce stores, campaigns can also respond to:

  • the product, category, tag, or variation being viewed,
  • cart contents and cart value,
  • applied coupons,
  • free-shipping thresholds,
  • the current checkout stage.

This lets you show a relevant message for each visitor instead of the same generic promotion to everyone.

Engage visitors onsite and bring them back

  • Popup – display an offer, form, or message based on the current page and visitor behavior.
  • Bar – highlight a promotion, limited-time offer, announcement, or free-shipping threshold in WooCommerce.
  • Embed – place a form, recommendation, or offer directly within a selected area of your website.
  • Feed – add an onsite panel where visitors can reopen current offers, updates, and recommendations while browsing.
  • Web push – remind visitors about a promotion, product, abandoned cart, or unfinished purchase after they leave.
  • WhatsApp – send offers and reminders, then continue the conversation when a customer replies.

Show the right message at the right time

You decide who sees a campaign, where it appears, and when it is triggered.

A campaign can respond to:

  • the current page,
  • whether this is the visitor’s first or a repeat visit,
  • visitor behavior, including exit intent,
  • device, language, and traffic source,
  • UTM parameters and login status,
  • scheduling and frequency controls.

Create campaigns without starting from scratch

Build a campaign yourself, customize a prebuilt template, or describe your goal to the AI Assistant. The Assistant can suggest campaign copy, layout, and calls to action.

Paid plans include support from an onboarding specialist who can help you configure DropUI, launch campaigns, review performance, and decide what to improve next.

How does it work?

  1. Install and connect – install the plugin and connect your WordPress website to a DropUI account.
  2. Create a campaign – start with a template, use the AI Assistant, or build your own campaign.
  3. Publish and optimize – choose targeting rules, publish the campaign, and track and improve its performance.

Start free or get expert support

Start with the free plan, or get 99% off the first month of a paid plan with the code DROPUI99. Paid plans start at $19 per month and include onboarding support. WhatsApp is available as a separately billed add-on channel.

If you already use another popup or marketing automation tool, you may be eligible for help migrating to DropUI for $1. The scope and terms are available on the migration offer page.

Explore all DropUI features

View current plans and pricing

Compatibility

The plugin requires WordPress 6.3 or newer.

The plugin was also tested up to WordPress 7.0.

Each WordPress site connects to DropUI independently. In a WordPress Multisite network, every site has its own DropUI connection, configuration, and campaigns.

External Service

This plugin connects your WordPress website to DropUI, an external software service. A DropUI account is required to create, publish, and analyze campaigns.

Service provider:
E-TRADE SOLUTIONS Sp. z o.o.

When the site administrator starts the connection process, the plugin sends the information required to identify and connect the WordPress website, including:

  • a unique site identifier,
  • the WordPress site name,
  • the site URL,
  • the connection callback URL,
  • the WordPress administrator email address,
  • the platform identifier,
  • information indicating whether the site already has an authentication secret.

For authenticated actions such as signing in to DropUI or disconnecting the site, the plugin sends a signed request containing the site identifier, the requested action, a timestamp, a nonce, and a cryptographic signature.

After you connect your website, the service may process information needed to select, display, and measure campaigns, including:

  • the URL of the page being visited,
  • campaign identifiers,
  • impressions, clicks, and conversions,
  • device, language, and traffic-source information,
  • user behavior related to a campaign,
  • information voluntarily submitted through forms, such as an email address or phone number.

If the website uses WooCommerce, the processed context may also include the product, category, variation, coupon, cart contents, cart value, and checkout stage.

The exact scope of processed information depends on the website configuration, enabled features, and active campaigns.

The plugin does not connect the site to DropUI until the site administrator explicitly starts the connection process.

sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for DropUI.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open DropUI in your WordPress dashboard.
  5. Sign in or create a DropUI account.
  6. Confirm that you want to connect your website.
  7. Choose a prebuilt campaign template or create your first campaign.

In a WordPress Multisite network, connect each site to DropUI separately.
sections.faq:
Can I set up DropUI myself, or do I have to start from scratch?

You can set it up yourself, and you do not have to start from scratch. After installing the plugin, choose a prebuilt campaign template, use the AI Assistant, or build a campaign yourself. You can launch your first campaign in a few straightforward steps.

Will I receive help with setup and campaign management?

Yes. Paid plans include support from an onboarding specialist who can help you configure DropUI, prepare and launch campaigns, and analyze their results.

Can I match campaigns to my website design?

Yes. You can customize the content, colors, layout, images, calls to action, and display behavior to match your brand and WordPress theme.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. DropUI also works on WordPress websites that do not use WooCommerce.

WooCommerce is only required for features that use products, categories, variations, coupons, cart contents, order value, or the checkout stage.

Can I target different visitors and measure campaign performance?

Yes. Campaigns can respond to the current page, device, traffic source, language, and visitor behavior.

In WooCommerce, campaigns can also use product, category, coupon, cart, order-value, and checkout-stage information.

You can track results using impressions, clicks, click-through rates, conversions, and A/B tests.

Do I need a DropUI account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WordPress website to the DropUI service, where campaigns are created, published, and measured.

Does DropUI send data to an external service?

Yes. The plugin connects your website to the DropUI service to create, publish, and measure campaigns. See the External Service section below for details about the service provider and processed data.

Does DropUI support WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Each site in a Multisite network connects to DropUI independently and has its own configuration and campaigns.

Where can I get support?

General questions about installation, activation, compatibility, and common plugin issues can be submitted through the WordPress.org support forum.

For questions about your account, payments, a specific site, campaign configuration, private data, or backend diagnostics, contact DropUI support.

DropUI support:
support@dropui.com

Registered users can also contact support through the DropUI panel.

  • Supports independent connections for sites in a WordPress Multisite network.
  • Does not require WooCommerce.
